verdict.rationale: Statsig documents an official CLI that can be integrated into CI/CD pipelines to automate management of Feature Gates and Experiments. It also offers a Console API for CRUD actions without the web UI and an HTTP API for evaluation and event logging without an SDK, which together cover headless automation. Missing for 10: detailed docs on non-interactive or CI authentication and pipeline examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
